_comment: Gemini CLI model rates, USD per million tokens, Google AI paid tier. Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (retrieved 2026-08-18). Hand-maintained from the vendor page rather than generated, because that page carries what a catalog flattens away: promotional windows with expiry dates, per-tier rates, and which rows share a price. Four caveats. (1) Tiered models (gemini-3.1-pro-preview and its -customtools twin, gemini-2.5-pro) charge more above a 200k-token prompt; this schema holds one rate per model, so the <=200k tier is used and long-context turns under-report. (2) Google bills no cache-write premium, so cache_write == input. (3) gemini-3.7-flash and gemini-3.6-flash carry promotional rates through 2026-12-31, after which both double — refresh this table then. (4) The `-latest` alias tags (gemini-flash-latest, gemini-flash-lite-latest) are deliberately absent: an alias is repointed at a new model without its name changing, so a rate pinned to one would silently misprice from the day it moves. They bill $0 and report themselves via unknown_model_events_total (P8-002), which is the honest failure.
